apps.title: AI Resume Builder
apps.description: Craft, tailor, and polish modern ATS-friendly resumes with multi-provider AI assistance. Supports OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Groq, and local Ollama models. Stores API keys securely using Web Crypto AES-GCM and Appshell secrets. Export directly to print-ready PDF, HTML, or structured JSON.
